notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Richman 11 has its new update! This time, we bring 2 brand new lords for everyone, come to meet “Bear” and “Yuan”.

For more details please check below:

notes.title: New Skins & New Map! Pt. 2
notes.content:
We are very glad to announce the 2nd part of Richman 11 content update! We prepare a brand new skin for all the male characters and a new map called "The City of Music"! What are you waiting for? Come and look what your favorite characters in new skins look like!

For details please check below:
v1.0.5 Patch Notes

1. Add new classic map "The City of Music".

2. Add new skins to all the male characters: "October", "Salonbus", "Ninja", "Big Gamester", "Miyamoto", "Daniel" and "John Joe".

3. Add online status.

4. Add community linked function.
a. Online mode, after entering game, players could check others' steam community page by clicking "players" in menu.
b. Players could check who the "recent played together players" are by clicking "Recent Played" of Steam.

5. Bugfixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985914/d06a4e1e411cdb83587d28fea0a6269fc566b300.png[/img]

tags.feature: 1. Add new classic map "The City of Music".
2. Add new skins to all the male characters: "October", "Salonbus", "Ninja", "Big Gamester", "Miyamoto", "Daniel" and "John Joe".
3. Add online status.
4. Add community linked function.
a. Online mode, after entering game, players could check others' steam community page by clicking "players" in menu.
b. Players could check who the "recent played together players" are by clicking "Recent Played" of Steam.

notes.title: New Skins & New Map!
notes.content:
We are very glad to announce Richman 11 has its first content update! We prepare a brand new skin for all the female characters and a new map! What are you waiting for? Come and look what your favorite characters in new skins look like!

Details of patch:
1.Add a new map “Carnival” for classic mode.

2.New skins for all female characters: Xiaomei, Miss Money, Baby King, Princess Sarah, Wu Mhi, Candy and Wumela.

3.Add “SAVE” function to local multi-player mode.

4.Fix the display bug of Hall.

5.Optimization on Loading page.

6.Improve the stocks interface display in English.

7.Improve the graphics of map “Snow Country” and “Angel Island”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985914/3757cb04b766c3d441501149e8256a6dbe2016e6.png[/img]

tags.feature: 1.Add a new map “Carnival” for classic mode.
2.New skins for all female characters: Xiaomei, Miss Money, Baby King, Princess Sarah, Wu Mhi, Candy and Wumela.
3.Add “SAVE” function to local multi-player mode.
5.Optimization on Loading page.
6.Improve the stocks interface display in English.
7.Improve the graphics of map “Snow Country” and “Angel Island”.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Bugfixes.

2. Main interface optimization.

3. Room interface optimization.

4. Optimization of function interface for some maps.

5. Optimization of character moving speed.

6. When creating a play, the default option of "Game Rounds" changes to "Time Limitation" from "No Limit", adding notification regarding "Game Rounds" in game as well. 

7. Add mechanism notification to the map "Sleepless Town".

8. Improve the graphic art of some cards.

9. Press "Tab" to check the overview of the play. 

This update will be implemented due at 11:00 AM (GMT+8), during the time, there will be short time maintenance of the servers, please be prepared, thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985914/998fc1244abbfcab5eec1e2e7c147c06314814f5.png[/img]

tags.bug: - Fixed an empty item panel sometimes showing on the scoreboard.
-DE_Library: Fixed bug where some clients would crash on bomb explosion.
- Fixed a bug where removing/adding a silencer would also drop a magazine on the ground.

tags.feature: - Added the Highlights feature.
- A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
